profile.headline: Associate Software Engineer at Optum
profile.summary:
Arkane Digital leverages my expertise in Next.js, TypeScript, and serverless architecture to build scalable, modular front-end components and API solutions. Working in a dynamic startup environment, I contribute to technical direction, triage tickets, and prioritize features to ensure efficient project delivery and seamless user experiences.

With a master’s degree in music performance from the San Francisco Conservatory of Music, I bring creativity and discipline to web development. My passion for building responsive, optimized websites complements my skills in Tailwind CSS and Decap CMS, enabling clients to manage content effectively while delivering high-quality user interfaces.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
- Built 30+ modular, production-grade components using Next.js and TypeScript, reducing UI code redundancy by 40%.
- Migrated backend endpoints from Next.js API routes to Azure Functions, increasing payload capacity by 100x to support large client data uploads without failures.
- Optimized frontend performance by reducing fetch call loading times by 50%, improving responsiveness and user experience.
- Led technical triage and architecture planning to prioritize and ship 15+ features, including a scalable roles and permissions system supporting fine-grained access control.
- Maintained a <48-hour bug resolution time while supporting 3 concurrent stakeholders across evolving product needs.
- Experimented with AI-assisted workflows: designed prompts for LLM-powered operations, including dynamic UDL form generation and automated retry handling.
- Presented biweekly sprint demos to business stakeholders, clearly communicating story outcomes and technical rationale.
positions.insights: Skills: Next.js · Sitecore · Scss · SASS · CSS · HTML · C# · .NET Framework · Sequelize.js

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented Decap CMS on Netlify, empowering clients to effortlessly manage and edit website content.
- Leveraged Next.js to optimize website performance and enhance search engine optimization (SEO) strategies.
- Designed responsive and visually appealing user interfaces using Tailwind CSS, streamlining development and improving user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Tailwind CSS · Next.js · TypeScript · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · Content Management Systems (CMS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a reusable form system that improved internal workflows for 1000+ client companies and grant applications.
- Acted as Scrum Master for 6 months: led 50+ standups, 10+ retrospectives, and maintained a 95% sprint completion rate.
- Designed and implemented robust CRUD systems covering 20+ new features and endpoints.
- Established testing protocols that reduced production bug reports by 60%.
- Built and deployed an AI-powered grant-matching system leveraging AWS Lambda and EventBridge to connect applicants with $50B+ in funding opportunities.
- Developed a role-based permissions system to strengthen app security and user access control.

positions.title: Guitar Teacher
positions.description:
- Mentored and guided 50+ students to understand and perform music
- Developed course material to create an engaging and exciting learning environment
- Facilitated group learning activities to foster collaboration and teamwork
- Provided personalized feedback to help students improve their musical abilities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with developers and designers to deliver 5+ responsive, accessible client websites under tight deadlines.
- Used Tailwind CSS to streamline styling and ensure consistent, mobile-first design standards.
